source.title: Highmark Stadium Food and Beverage Offerings For 2026 Season

notes: Inaugural Highmark Stadium / Legends Global 2026 menu from the official Buffalo Bills article (Aug 12, 2026), with neighborhood-market stand names confirmed by on-site 2026 reporting. Existing Stadium Slop rows are a 2026 headline CSV import of prior-stadium/creative names (Charlie the Butcher, La Nova, Miller Lite Brew Pub, numeric sections). Those rows stay active as STALE_REVIEW unless they are clearly the same 2026 SKU (Beef on Weck, Tim Hortons Coffee). No prices are published. Do not reuse old Orchard Park stand identities.

items.name: Beef on Weck
items.description: Official 2026 Highmark/Legends Beef on Weck: Wegmans kimmelweck roll, top round, au jus, horseradish, and a dill pickle spear. Sold at Kaisertown. No price is published.
items.notes: UPDATE of canonical CSV Beef on Weck. Official 2026 SKU uses Wegmans kimmelweck, top round, au jus, and horseradish. Vendor renamed from Beef on Weck to Kaisertown (neighborhood stand on the inaugural Highmark concourse). Do not keep Charlie the Butcher — that is prior-stadium.

items.name: Tim Hortons Coffee
items.description: Official 2026 Highmark drinks list includes Tim Hortons Coffee. No price is published.
items.notes: UPDATE of the CSV vendor-as-item Tim Hortons row. Official 2026 drinks list confirms Tim Hortons Coffee. Timbits / Blue & Red donut from the CSV are not on the official inaugural menu.

items.name: Rizzo's Chicken Parm Sandwich
items.description: Matty Matheson's official 2026 Highmark sandwich: Portuguese roll, chicken cutlet, pomodoro, mozzarella, parmesan, roasted peppers, and garlic parmesan dressing. No price is published.
items.notes: Official Bills article names this Rizzo's Chicken Parm Sandwich / Chicken Parm Sub.

items.name: Chicken Finger Sub

items.notes: Stand mapping from inaugural Highmark neighborhood-market reporting; SKU from official Bills menu.

staleReview.evidence: Positive evidence: absent from the official inaugural 2026 Highmark/Legends menu. CSV used old-style section numbers (124 & 306) that do not match the new neighborhood-market concourse. Left active; do not auto-hide.

Positive evidence: official 2026 SKU is Beef on Weck (Wegmans kimmelweck, au jus, horseradish), not Queen City Weck with horseradish beer cheese fondue. CSV location '716 Stands' is prior-stadium language. Left active; do not auto-hide.

Positive evidence: not on the official 2026 Highmark menu. Official chicken items are Chicken Fingers / Buffalo Chicken Fingers with Treasure Cave Blue Cheese, not an all-dressed chip spice blend. CSV located it at Miller Lite Brew Pub, which is not a 2026 Highmark market. Left active.
Positive evidence: flank-steak MVP sandwich is absent from the official 2026 sandwich list (Beef on Weck, Chicken Finger Sub, Bills Mafia Stinger, Royal Sub, Rizzo's Chicken Parm). Left active.
Positive evidence: not on the official inaugural Highmark/Legends menu. Left active.

Positive evidence: malformed CSV row (Sahlen's dogs attached to La Nova Wings). Official 2026 SKU is Loaded Footlong Hotdog on Sahlen's, created as a new Black Rock item rather than rewriting this wrong vendor attachment. Left active.
Positive evidence: official 2026 frozen dessert collaborator is Anderson's Frozen Custard, not Perry's. Left active.
Positive evidence: this is a place-as-item leftover. Official 2026 beer marketplaces are Bud Light Marketplace and Pepsi Marketplace, not a Miller Lite Brew Pub food item. Left active.

Positive evidence: souvenir carafe / Bills Blue Lemonade is not on the official 2026 Highmark drink list. Official souvenir cocktail is the Tart Cherry Smash bowling-ball cup. Left active.
Positive evidence: not on the official 2026 Highmark menu. Official vegetarian plates include Cauliflower Foldie and Smoked Street Veg at Southern Junction. Left active.
